case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We have looked at them carefully, and our own records show a different picture:

Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

On that basis we cannot accept the proposed price, but we would like to give you a solid basis for a longer partnership. Each option below runs for a longer term, giving you planning security:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.54; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.38; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.50; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

All three are genuine options, set out so they can go straight to your pricing committee. If your approval needs any further detail from us, just let us know.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We have carefully reviewed your historical purchase data and acknowledge the pricing levels from your previous orders.
We welcome the proposed 24-month contract term to provide mutual planning security; however, for this duration, we must apply the AS-14404 index clause as we cannot offer a fixed price over two years.
By incorporating the index clause, we are able to reduce the base price to EUR 5.48 per unit with a 30-day payment term.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.48 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your quick and constructive reply, and for acknowledging our purchase history. We appreciate that.

We share your interest in a longer partnership. All three options below offer the contract term you asked for, giving both sides the planning security you mentioned. We would prefer to keep prices fixed rather than indexed, and each option balances price against payment terms differently.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.48; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.32; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.44; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

To make internal approval easy, we are glad to confirm any option in writing or provide whatever summary your pricing committee needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present our updated terms to support your ongoing requirements.

Our updated offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We appreciate your constructive approach, but for a 24-month contract duration, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause to responsibly manage material cost fluctuations. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. This adjustment provides the planning security you seek while ensuring a sustainable pricing model for both parties over the long term.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.48 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Option B: unit price EUR 5.32; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

To make your internal approval easier, we are happy to provide any summary or further details your pricing committee needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We note that your proposed options remain unchanged from your previous communication. As previously stated, a 24-month contract requires the AS-14404 index clause to responsibly manage material cost fluctuations. We therefore maintain our current offer and kindly ask you to reconsider our terms.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

We stand by our terms at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.
